nodes.title: Nonexistence of a minimal simple odd-order group

nodes.title: Solvability from solvable proper subgroups and proper normal quotients
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ {G : Type*} [Group G] [Finite G], Odd (Nat.card G) → (∀ M : Subgroup G, M < ⊤ → Group.IsSolvable M) → (∀ (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal], N ≠ ⊥ → N < ⊤ → Group.IsSolvable (G ⧸ N)) → Group.IsSolvable G

nodes.title: Appendix-C norm set has at least two elements
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (p q : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], Odd p → q.Prime → Odd q → Nat.Coprime ((p ^ q - 1) / (p - 1)) (p - 1) → let normN : GaloisField p q → GaloisField p q := fun x => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range q, x ^ (p ^ i); let E : Set (GaloisField p q) := {a | normN a = 1 ∧ normN (2 - a) = 1}; 2 ≤ E.ncard

nodes.title: Appendix-C generator relation forces p ≤ q
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (p q : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], Odd p → q.Prime → Odd q → Nat.Coprime ((p ^ q - 1) / (p - 1)) (p - 1) → (let normN : GaloisField p q → GaloisField p q := fun x => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range q, x ^ (p ^ i); let E : Set (GaloisField p q) := {a | normN a = 1 ∧ normN (2 - a) = 1}; ∀ a, a ∈ E → normN ((2 : GaloisField p q) * a - 1) = 1) → p ≤ q

nodes.title: Extract field-normalizer norm data from a minimal simple odd-order group
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ {K : Type*} [Group K] [Finite K], Odd (Nat.card K) → IsSimpleGroup K → (¬ Group.IsSolvable K) → (∀ M : Subgroup K, M < ⊤ → Group.IsSolvable M) → ∃ (p q : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime), Odd p ∧ q.Prime ∧ Odd q ∧ q < p ∧ Nat.Coprime ((p ^ q - 1) / (p - 1)) (p - 1) ∧ (letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩; let normN : GaloisField p q → GaloisField p q := fun x => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range q, x ^ (p ^ i); let E : Set (GaloisField p q) := {a | normN a = 1 ∧ normN (2 - a) = 1}; ∀ a, a ∈ E → normN ((2 : GaloisField p q) * a - 1) = 1)

nodes.title: A nontrivial simultaneous norm-one element in the cubic extension
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], Odd p → let normN : GaloisField p 3 → GaloisField p 3 := fun x => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range 3, x ^ (p ^ i); ∃ a : GaloisField p 3, a ≠ 1 ∧ normN a = 1 ∧ normN (2 - a) = 1

nodes.title: Character-theoretic discrepancy bound for the simultaneous norm-one set
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (p q : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], Odd p → 0 < q → let normN : GaloisField p q → GaloisField p q := fun x => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range q, x ^ (p ^ i); let E : Set (GaloisField p q) := {a | normN a = 1 ∧ normN (2 - a) = 1}; let M : ℕ := (p ^ q - 1) / (p - 1); let D : ℝ := (p : ℝ) ^ q; |(M : ℝ) ^ 2 - (E.ncard : ℝ) * D| ≤ D * Real.sqrt D

nodes.title: Numerical separation beyond extension degree four
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (p q : ℕ), 2 ≤ p → 5 ≤ q → let M : ℕ := (p ^ q - 1) / (p - 1); let D : ℝ := (p : ℝ) ^ q; D * Real.sqrt D < (M : ℝ) ^ 2 - D

nodes.title: The generator relation propagates norm one along an affine line
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (p q : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], 0 < q → let normN : GaloisField p q → GaloisField p q := fun x => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range q, x ^ (p ^ i); let E : Set (GaloisField p q) := {a | normN a = 1 ∧ normN (2 - a) = 1}; (∀ a, a ∈ E → normN ((2 : GaloisField p q) * a - 1) = 1) → ∀ a, a ∈ E → ∀ k : ℕ, normN (1 + (k : GaloisField p q) * (1 - a)) = 1

nodes.title: Norm-one affine-line identities force the prime-field root bound
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (p q : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], 0 < q → let normN : GaloisField p q → GaloisField p q := fun x => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range q, x ^ (p ^ i); ∀ a : GaloisField p q, a ≠ 1 → (∀ k : ℕ, normN (1 + (k : GaloisField p q) * (1 - a)) = 1) → p ≤ q

nodes.title: Derive the norm generator relation from twisted norm-one data
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (p q : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime), Odd p → 0 < q → (letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩; let normN : GaloisField p q → GaloisField p q := fun x => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range q, x ^ (p ^ i); ∀ (U : Subgroup (GaloisField p q)ˣ) (φ : MulAut U), (∀ u : (GaloisField p q)ˣ, u ∈ U ↔ normN (u : GaloisField p q) = 1) → φ ^ p = 1 → (∀ u : U, normN (2 - ((u : (GaloisField p q)ˣ) : GaloisField p q)) = 1 → normN (2 - ((φ (u⁻¹) : (GaloisField p q)ˣ) : GaloisField p q)) = 1) → ∀ a : GaloisField p q, normN a = 1 ∧ normN (2 - a) = 1 → normN ((2 : GaloisField p q) * a - 1) = 1)

nodes.title: Odd twisted-inversion stability implies inverse closure
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ {A : Type*} [Group A] (φ : MulAut A) (S : Set A) (n : ℕ), Odd n → φ ^ n = 1 → (∀ x : A, x ∈ S → φ (x⁻¹) ∈ S) → ∀ x : A, x ∈ S → x⁻¹ ∈ S

nodes.title: Construct the norm-one subgroup and its twisted action
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ {K : Type*} [Group K] [Finite K], Odd (Nat.card K) → IsSimpleGroup K → (¬ Group.IsSolvable K) → (∀ M : Subgroup K, M < ⊤ → Group.IsSolvable M) → ∃ (p q : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime), Odd p ∧ q.Prime ∧ Odd q ∧ q < p ∧ Nat.Coprime ((p ^ q - 1) / (p - 1)) (p - 1) ∧ (letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩; let normN : GaloisField p q → GaloisField p q := fun x => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range q, x ^ (p ^ i); ∃ (U : Subgroup (GaloisField p q)ˣ) (φ : MulAut U), (∀ u : (GaloisField p q)ˣ, u ∈ U ↔ normN (u : GaloisField p q) = 1) ∧ φ ^ p = 1 ∧ ∀ u : U, normN (2 - ((u : (GaloisField p q)ˣ) : GaloisField p q)) = 1 → normN (2 - ((φ (u⁻¹) : (GaloisField p q)ˣ) : GaloisField p q)) = 1)

nodes.title: Factorization along a nontrivial cubic Frobenius orbit
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (a : GaloisField p 3), f.Monic → f.natDegree = 3 → (f.map (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p 3))).eval a = 0 → (∀ d : ZMod p, a ≠ algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p 3) d) → f.map (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p 3)) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range 3, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (a ^ (p ^ i)))

nodes.title: Realizing a root-free cubic outside the prime field
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)), f.Monic → f.natDegree = 3 → (∀ d : ZMod p, f.eval d ≠ 0) → ∃ a : GaloisField p 3, (f.map (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p 3))).eval a = 0 ∧ ∀ d : ZMod p, a ≠ algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p 3) d

nodes.title: A root-free member of the cubic family
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], Odd p → ∃ c : ZMod p, let f : Polynomial (ZMod p) := Polynomial.X * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C 2) * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c) + (Polynomial.X - 1); f.Monic ∧ f.natDegree = 3 ∧ ∀ d : ZMod p, f.eval d ≠ 0

nodes.title: Character moments for additive intersections of a multiplicative subgroup
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (F : Type) [Field F] [Finite F] (U : Subgroup Fˣ) (c : F), c ≠ 0 → let A : Set F := {a | (∃ u : U, ((u : Fˣ) : F) = a) ∧ (∃ v : U, ((v : Fˣ) : F) = c - a)}; ∃ r : ℕ, ∃ z w : Fin r → ℂ, (Nat.card F : ℂ) * (A.ncard : ℂ) = (Nat.card U : ℂ) ^ 2 + (∑ j : Fin r, z j ^ 2 * star (w j)) ∧ (∑ j : Fin r, ‖z j‖ ^ 2) ≤ (Nat.card F : ℝ) ∧ (∑ j : Fin r, ‖w j‖ ^ 2) ≤ (Nat.card F : ℝ)

nodes.title: Bound a cubic complex sum using two second-moment bounds
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (r : ℕ) (z w : Fin r → ℂ) (D : ℝ), 0 ≤ D → (∑ j : Fin r, ‖z j‖ ^ 2) ≤ D → (∑ j : Fin r, ‖w j‖ ^ 2) ≤ D → ‖∑ j : Fin r, z j ^ 2 * star (w j)‖ ≤ D * Real.sqrt D

nodes.title: Realize the norm-one fiber as a subgroup of the expected order
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (p q : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], 0 < q → let normN : GaloisField p q → GaloisField p q := fun x => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range q, x ^ (p ^ i); let M : ℕ := (p ^ q - 1) / (p - 1); ∃ U : Subgroup (GaloisField p q)ˣ, Nat.card U = M ∧ ∀ a : GaloisField p q, normN a = 1 ↔ ∃ u : U, ((u : (GaloisField p q)ˣ) : GaloisField p q) = a
